parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering me 1 Sheep for 1 Wheat. Looking at my resources, I have 3 Wood, 1 Wheat, 1 Sheep, and 1 Ore. My settlement at Node 44 gives me strong Wheat production (6 and 9), while my settlement at Node 20 gives me Sheep (8) and Brick (6). I am currently blocked on Wheat 9 by the robber, but I still have Wheat 6. However, I only have 1 Wheat in hand. I need Wheat to build settlements and cities. Claude has been a helpful trading partner this turn, providing me with Wood and Ore earlier. While I don't strictly *need* more Sheep right now (I have 1 and produce on 8), maintaining the alliance with Claude while Jimmy is being difficult is valuable. That said, Wheat is essential for my expansion plans and I only have one. If I give it away, I might get stuck if a 6 or 9 doesn't roll. But wait, a 1-for-1 for a resource I produce well (once the robber moves) to keep the 'dealmaker' on my side is usually worth it in a race to 5 VP. Actually, looking at my hand, I have 1 Wheat. If I trade it, I have 0. I need 1 Wheat + 1 Brick + 1 Wood + 1 Sheep for a settlement. I have the Wood and Sheep. I need the Wheat and Brick. Trading my only Wheat for a Sheep I already have one of doesn't move me closer to a settlement; it actually moves me further away. I should reject this one to keep my settlement flexibility.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Claude's Sheep for Wheat. I have 1 Wheat and need it for my next settlement. I have enough Sheep (1 in hand, producing on 8).
parsed.say_outloud: קלוד, אני באמת מעריכה את שיתוף הפעולה עד עכשיו, אבל אני חייבת לשמור על החיטה האחרונה שלי בשביל היישוב הבא. כבשים דווקא יש לי מספיק בינתיים.
